description: This file defines an abstract base class for a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter used within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides core functionalities for starting/stopping HTTP servers (both secure and insecure), routing, tracing, metrics, and handling of telemetry, events, commands, and responses. The class is intended to be extended for specific protocol implementations and manages key aspects of request handling, including command consumers, time-to-disconnect (TTD), and connection lifecycle management.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class providing core HTTP protocol adapter functionalities for the Eclipse Hono framework, including server management, routing, tracing, and message handling, to be extended for specific protocols.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes and binds secure and insecure HTTP servers with appropriate routes and handlers, handling startup logic.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates and configures a Vert.x Web Router with handlers for metrics, tracing, error handling, body size limiting, and trace sampling.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to add custom request routes to the router.

methods.name: uploadTelemetryMessage
methods.description: Uploads telemetry data received via HTTP to the Hono system.

methods.name: uploadEventMessage
methods.description: Uploads event data received via HTTP to the Hono system.

methods.name: uploadCommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Processes and uploads command response data received via HTTP to the Hono system.
